sentences.en: Can you believe how quickly this year has gone by? It feels like just yesterday we were celebrating New Year's Eve together.
sentences.zh: 你能相信今年過得有多快嗎？感覺就像昨天我們還在一起慶祝跨年。

sentences.en: The weather has been absolutely gorgeous lately, which makes it nearly impossible to stay indoors and focus on getting any work done.
sentences.zh: 最近天氣真的很棒，這讓人幾乎不可能待在室內專心做任何工作。

sentences.en: I tried that new Thai restaurant around the corner last night, and the green curry they serve is honestly the best I've had in this city.
sentences.zh: 我昨晚試了轉角那家新的泰式餐廳，他們的綠咖哩老實說是我在這個城市吃過最好的。

sentences.en: Have you been watching that documentary series everyone's been raving about on Netflix? I started it last weekend and couldn't stop.
sentences.zh: 你有在看Netflix上大家都在狂推的那個紀錄片系列嗎？我上週末開始看就停不下來。

sentences.en: The traffic this morning was absolutely terrible — it took me nearly an hour just to get here, when it normally takes about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 今天早上的交通簡直糟透了——我花了將近一小時才到這裡，平常大約只要二十分鐘。

sentences.en: I heard they're finally opening that new bookstore downtown next month, which is exciting because we really needed one in this neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我聽說他們下個月終於要在市中心開那家新書店了，這很令人興奮因為我們這個社區真的需要一家。

sentences.en: My neighbor just adopted the most adorable golden retriever puppy, and now I'm seriously considering getting a dog of my own.
sentences.zh: 我鄰居剛收養了一隻最可愛的黃金獵犬幼犬，現在我認真在考慮自己也養一隻狗。

sentences.en: Did you happen to catch the game last night? The final score was unbelievable — nobody expected such a dramatic comeback in the last quarter.
sentences.zh: 你昨晚有看到那場比賽嗎？最終比分令人難以置信——沒人預料到最後一節會有如此戲劇性的逆轉。

sentences.en: I've been trying to cut back on coffee lately, but it's proving to be much harder than I anticipated, especially on Monday mornings.
sentences.zh: 我最近一直試著減少喝咖啡，但事實證明這比我預想的困難得多，特別是在星期一早上。

sentences.en: The podcast my coworker recommended about unsolved mysteries has become my go-to entertainment during my daily commute on the train.
sentences.zh: 我同事推薦的那個關於未解之謎的播客已經成為我每天搭火車通勤時的首選娛樂。

sentences.en: I can't believe how expensive groceries have gotten this year — my weekly shopping bill has practically doubled compared to what it was before.
sentences.zh: 我不敢相信今年雜貨變得有多貴——我每週的購物帳單跟以前比幾乎翻倍了。

sentences.en: Speaking of weekend plans, a few of us are thinking about checking out that farmer's market that just opened near the waterfront.
sentences.zh: 說到週末計劃，我們幾個人在考慮去看看海濱附近剛開的那個農夫市集。

sentences.en: The construction on Main Street has been going on for months now, and I honestly have no idea when they're planning to finish it.
sentences.zh: 大街上的施工已經持續好幾個月了，我真的不知道他們打算什麼時候完工。

sentences.en: I finally got around to watching that movie you recommended last time, and you were absolutely right — the plot twist at the end was incredible.
sentences.zh: 我終於看了你上次推薦的那部電影，你完全說對了——結尾的劇情翻轉太精彩了。

sentences.en: My apartment building's elevator has been broken for three days straight, which is particularly frustrating since I live on the twelfth floor.
sentences.zh: 我公寓大樓的電梯已經連續壞了三天，這特別令人沮喪因為我住在十二樓。

sentences.en: Have you noticed that the café across the street changed their menu recently? They've added some interesting seasonal drinks that I'd love to try.
sentences.zh: 你有注意到對街的咖啡廳最近換了菜單嗎？他們增加了一些有趣的季節性飲品，我很想試試。

sentences.en: The cherry blossoms in the park are absolutely stunning right now — I took about fifty photos on my walk this morning and they all look amazing.
sentences.zh: 公園裡的櫻花現在絕對是美不勝收——我今早散步時拍了大約五十張照片，每張都很好看。

sentences.en: I spent the entire weekend binge-watching a new series, which I probably shouldn't admit, but it was honestly too addictive to stop.
sentences.zh: 我整個週末都在追一部新劇，我可能不應該承認，但它真的太讓人上癮了停不下來。

sentences.en: Did you hear that our favorite lunch spot is closing at the end of the month? I'm genuinely devastated because their sandwiches were legendary.
sentences.zh: 你聽說我們最喜歡的午餐地方月底要關了嗎？我真的很難過因為他們的三明治是傳奇般的好吃。

sentences.en: The sunset yesterday was one of the most spectacular I've ever seen — the sky turned this incredible shade of orange that lasted for nearly half an hour.
sentences.zh: 昨天的日落是我見過的最壯觀的之一——天空變成了一種令人難以置信的橙色，持續了將近半小時。

sentences.en: I've been meaning to ask if you've tried that new fitness app everyone at the office keeps talking about — apparently the guided workouts are excellent.
sentences.zh: 我一直想問你有沒有試過辦公室每個人都在討論的那個新健身app——據說引導式運動課程非常棒。

sentences.en: My sister just sent me the cutest video of her baby taking his first steps, and I must have watched it at least twenty times already.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐剛寄給我她寶寶邁出第一步的最可愛影片，我一定已經看了至少二十次了。

sentences.en: The air conditioning in our office has been acting up again, which means we're all either freezing or sweating depending on the hour.
sentences.zh: 我們辦公室的空調又出問題了，這表示我們要不就是凍得發抖要不就是汗流浹背，取決於幾點。

sentences.en: I stumbled upon the most charming little antique shop last weekend while I was wandering around the old part of town with no particular destination.
sentences.zh: 上週末我在漫無目的地逛老城區時偶然發現了一家最迷人的小古董店。

sentences.en: Isn't it funny how time seems to fly when you're on vacation but crawls by at an agonizing pace during a boring meeting?
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，度假時時間似乎飛逝而過，但在無聊的會議中卻以痛苦的速度爬行，是不是？

sentences.en: The book I'm currently reading, which a friend lent me ages ago, has turned out to be surprisingly engaging despite its rather dull cover.
sentences.zh: 我目前在讀的那本書，朋友很久以前借我的，結果出奇地引人入勝，儘管封面相當平淡。

sentences.en: I overheard someone on the bus talking about a free outdoor concert happening this Friday, and I'm thinking we should definitely check it out.
sentences.zh: 我在公車上聽到有人在談論這週五有場免費的戶外音樂會，我想我們一定要去看看。

sentences.en: Every time I promise myself I'll go to bed early, I end up scrolling through my phone for another hour without even realizing it.
sentences.zh: 每次我向自己保證要早睡，結果不知不覺又滑了一個小時的手機。

sentences.en: The view from my new apartment is actually quite nice — on clear days I can see the mountains in the distance, which I wasn't expecting.
sentences.zh: 我新公寓的視野其實相當不錯——天氣好的時候我能看到遠處的山，這是我沒料到的。

sentences.en: I keep meaning to organize my closet, but every time I start, I get distracted by old photos and letters that I'd completely forgotten about.
sentences.zh: 我一直想整理衣櫃，但每次開始，我都被完全忘記的舊照片和信件分散了注意力。
